answer: Work waits on the vertex until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the voyage of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the falcon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
